MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The magnet wire felt like a natural next choice because I previously bought ferrite cores and could use winding wire to experiment with transformers or inductors.",
    "My breadboards, relay module, and PCB supplies make electrical project materials relevant, although only the magnet wire met a clear enough need for me to choose it now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing relates to wiring, but its stated diameter looks too large for my small electronics work; having the same general purpose is not enough if the dimensions do not fit.",
    "The screws, nuts, and pipe fitting require specific matching parts or an active assembly job, neither of which is established by my purchases.",
    "Polishing compound, grinder wheels, sealant, oil, and masks do not follow from a current need I recognize, so general practical usefulness would not make me choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My occasional purchases of casters and fasteners seem to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "An interest in electrical materials seems to have been treated as enough to recommend wire insulation without considering its size or intended application."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between ferrite cores and winding wire matters more to me than a broad resemblance between unrelated tools and supplies.",
    "My purchases span years and different tasks; buying an item for one project does not mean I currently need supplies for other maintenance jobs.",
    "Dimensions, compatible parts, and quantities matter: I need a concrete use before choosing a hardware assortment or fifty cutting wheels."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my electronics interests but generalized too broadly into workshop supplies without enough attention to project purpose and fit."
}
